verdicts_or_reports.observed: Quantity resets to maximum 25 on rotation; reproduced with 12 and 1.
steps: Skills > Smithing > Bronze Bar
Set quantity 12
Rotate landscape and portrait: quantity resets to 25
Set quantity 1 and repeat rotation: resets to 25 again

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Opens Combat with Gear tab selected.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Opens Dungeons tab instead; reproduced by returning to Profile Gear and using link again.
steps: Profile > Gear
Tap View Combat Gear
Observe Dungeons selected
Return to Profile > Gear and tap View Combat Gear again

verdicts_or_reports.expected: XP preview includes projected level and progress; 4400 +155 =4555 XP reaches level 20 (+1, 15%).
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Only total XP shown, with no projected level or progress, although Home shows '+155 XP  →  Lv 20 (+1, 15%)' for the same batch. Reopening reproduces.
steps: Start at Smithing 19, 4400 XP
Open Smithing > Bronze Bar, quantity 25
Observe XP preview lacks level projection
Craft batch and compare Home projection
Abandon (ingredients refunded), reopen same batch and observe omission again

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Mining list includes higher-level ores, including Mithril at level 50, and permits scrolling to later locked ores.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: List ends at Gold Ore (level 40). Repeated upward swipes cannot reveal Mithril or higher-level ores; reopening reproduces.
steps: At Mining level 50 open Skills > Mining
Swipe upward repeatedly
Last accessible entry is Gold Ore, no Mithril or later ores
Close and reopen Mining and repeat swipes

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Equipment candidates ranked strongest first so Gilded Platebody (+95 Defense) precedes weaker body items.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Candidates run weakest first: Mithril +48, Runite Chainbody +60, Adamantite +66, Slayer +80, Runite Platebody +90, Gilded +95. Reopening preserves reversed strength ordering; weapon chooser similarly puts Bronze Dagger before Iron Sword.
steps: Combat > Gear > Body
Inspect candidate order with six precondition body items
Dismiss and reopen Body: same weakest-first order
Compare Weapon (Atk): Bronze Dagger precedes Iron Sword

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Agility Cape requires level 99 Agility; at level 20 it should not be an eligible equippable cape merely because it is in inventory.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: At Agility 20 the chooser lists Agility Cape and equips it successfully, applying +5 Defense and +10% XP. Reproduced after unequipping and selecting again.
steps: With precondition Agility Cape owned and Agility 20 open Combat > Gear > Cape
Select Agility Cape; equipped successfully
Unequip cape
Reopen chooser and select Agility Cape again: equipped successfully

sign_off.notes: Swept smithing/crafting batch selection, quantity boundaries, cancel/abandon and refunds, XP consistency; gear/tools choices, swaps, unequip, empty slots, style filtering, persistence and rotation; mining displayed level order, selection and abandon, reopening and rotation.
